title: Can I MASTER Passant?
summary: Second Passant video (demo, normal AI): continues his saved run for two more stages and finishes the demo. Buys Spare Change (+$3 per round), a Gold Empress (rook+knight; golden = +$1 if still on board after a win), rearranges his setup (Courtisan on the kingside: enemy pieces adjacent to it can't move). Round options list alternative win conditions (6 checks, checkmate, capture all non-king pieces, +10 score in two turns, survive 20 turns without capture). Boss 1: enemy king replaced by a Dragon King (moves as a queen). Later buys a Cannon and the Atomic badge (all units explode when captured); final boss modifier Double Rainbow (3 random enemy pieces become rainbow - they spawn a random friendly piece when taken). Wins by blowing up pieces; demo ends ('First challenge level unlocked').
rules: Passant: a chess roguelike (demo / full release). You play White on an 8x8 board with a small purchasable army against the AI's preset enemy army each round.
Each round you may choose Standard, Challenging (harder enemy army, better reward), or Skip.
Round win: checkmate the enemy king OR deliver six checks (a check counter).
Rewards: money ($) per round (+ bonuses, e.g. capturing some pieces pays $1).
SHOP between rounds: buy pieces (e.g. Bishop, Rook, Knight, Empress = rook+knight, Courtisan, Amazon = queen+knight), coins and badges; Re-roll; Next Stage.

Coins are one-shot consumables used on the board: Queen coin (promote a pawn of your choice to a queen), Pawn coin, Demotion coin (demote an enemy piece to a weaker one), Money coin (sell one of your pieces for half its value, rounded down).

Badges are passive perks, e.g. Coin Machine (receive a demotion coin at the start of each round), Window Shopper (rerolls cost $1), 'mark one square; if a friendly piece moves there receive a random coin', 'give a random piece on your setup board a special modifier'.
Boss rounds carry modifiers (e.g. Fischer Random start) and cost/award more.
AI difficulty setting: Standard / Challenging / Grandmaster.
Round win-condition options seen: give check six turns in a row / checkmate / capture all non-king pieces / +10 score within two turns / 20 turns without a capture (reduced reward).

Pieces: Courtisan - enemy pieces adjacent to it may not be moved. Man - moves like a king (non-royal). Empress - rook + knight. Gold/Golden piece - gain $1 if still on the board after winning a match. Cannon (exact move not explained; used to capture and trigger explosions). Zombie pawns (shop item; behaviour not explained).

Badges: Hidden Treasure (mark a square; friendly piece moving there gains $3), Spare Change (+$3 at round end), Discount Card (shop items $1 less), Lazy Present (mark a square; random coin), Atomic (all units explode when captured, destroying adjacent pieces).
Coins: demote selected unit to a pawn ($3); transform your lowest-value setup piece into one 1-3 value higher.

Boss modifiers: Dragon King - boss king moves as a queen. Double Rainbow - at match start three random enemy pieces become rainbow; rainbow pieces spawn a random friendly piece (for their owner) when taken.
Your setup can be rearranged on your first two ranks before a round.
win_condition: Clear the demo's stages (boss rounds included); each round by its chosen win condition.
